groups.title: A four-team league
groups.text:
Four teams, P, Q, R and S, play a league in which each pair of teams meets once. A win earns 3 points, a draw 1 point to each team and a loss nothing. At the end:

1. P has 7 points, more than any other team.
2. Q has 5 points and did not lose a match.
3. R won exactly one match.
4. S has fewer points than R.
5. S drew at least one match.

questions.text: How many points does R have?
What was the result of Q v S?
How many matches in the league ended in a draw?
If condition 5 were removed, which of these would still be certain?
